title: Shiny new components
body:
A fresh look at the PC components in Code Review Simulator: the case, motherboard, graphics card, processor, memory, cooling, power supply, storage and fans.

The video takes a tour of the individual parts and brings them together in a complete PC assembly, with fitted proportions, subtle finishes and plenty of small details.

videos.caption: A tour of the new PC components and the complete assembly in Code Review Simulator.
